title: dsh-plugins catalog manifest
description: Machine-readable catalog of the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) packages published from the xarleyn/dsh-plugins monorepo. Generated by scripts/generate-plugins-manifest.mjs and verified by scripts/verify-package-hygiene.mjs.

generatedBy.description: Repository script that regenerates this file.

repository.description: Canonical git repository hosting every listed package.

githubTopic.description: GitHub topic every package repository carries, used by DSH plugin indexers that discover packages by topic.

plugins.description: Every publishable package in the monorepo, ordered by directory. Each entry declares its kind, so a reader can tell a package the Host registers from a package a consumer imports.

name.description: Workspace directory name, which is also the runtime DSH plugin id.

npm.description: Full npm package name, including its scope.

path.description: Monorepo directory of the package, relative to the repository root.

description.description: Package description, copied from its package.json.

keywords.description: Package keywords, copied from its package.json.

kind.description: Install contract of the package: "plugin" is a standalone DSH plugin the Host registers (it declares dsh.bundle and ships a Cordis patch), "library" is a shared runtime package another package imports and cannot be registered.

install.description: Install command matching the kind: profile plugin registration for a plugin, package-manager dependency add for a library.

homepage.description: Documentation entry point for the package.

client.description: True when the package ships a browser client bundle.
